title: Collection file
description: One hand-authored file per built-in collection. Items are listed inline, in the order they are recited; the build script assigns positions 1..N in file order and derives collection_items.id as collection_id * 1000 + position.

id.description: Author-assigned, globally unique across all collection files, permanent.

author.description: Optional compiler or author of the litany, e.g. the scholar it is attributed to. Omit when unused.

type.description: wird = a structured litany with a fixed order; dhikr_set = a loose set of adhkar; surah_set = a set of surahs or ayahs.

sort_order.description: Display order among collections. Lower sorts first.

items.description: Recitation order. Exactly one of dhikr / ayah / surah per item.

dhikr.description: A dhikr id from content/sources/adhkar/. Must resolve at build time.

ayah.description: An ayah reference as "surah:ayah", e.g. "2:255", or an inclusive range within one surah, e.g. "2:285-286". A range expands to one item per ayah, each taking the next position.

surah.description: A whole surah by number, e.g. 36.

count.description: Optional. Repetitions of this single item, overriding the dhikr's default_count. Omit when the default is correct.

repeat_group.description: Optional. Groups consecutive items that are repeated together as a block. Items sharing a value must be contiguous and must agree on repeat_group_count. Numbering is per collection.

repeat_group_count.description: Optional. How many times the whole repeat_group block is repeated. Required whenever repeat_group is set, and vice versa.

note.description: Optional per-item note shown to the user, e.g. a rubric. Omit when unused.
